description: This file defines the TailscaleNetwork enum with functions to identify and detect Tailscale IPv4 addresses within network interfaces.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address string belongs to the Tailscale tailnet range.

methods.name: detectTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Detects and returns the first IPv4 address from the network interfaces that belongs to the Tailscale tailnet range.
